description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pathokwewa, Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120068
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership status (primarily by The State), and other land-related particulars. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration, ownership determinations, and property details, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes classification.
